attr.title: Dijeweled Remastered
attr.desc: Dijeweled Remastered is a fan-made recreation of the Bejeweled series by LDinos. It brings back match-3 modes such as Classic, Zen, Blitz, Twist and Quests, and adds new gems, new modes and multiplayer.
attr.inst: Ready to run out of the box, no additional files needed.
